repo_info.description: An step by step fuzzing tutorial. A GitHub Security Lab initiative

items.title: FuzzUSB: Hybrid Stateful Fuzzing of USB Gadget Stacks, 2022

items.description: A curated collection of open-source fuzzing tools, grouped by their primary testing target. Each tool appears in one category; its description identifies the relevant interfaces and techniques. Tools are selected for research relevance, availability of official implementations, and documented capabilities.

children.title: AFL++
children.description: (2019) - A superior fork to Google's AFL with more speed, more and better mutations, more and better instrumentation, and custom module support.

repo_info.description: The fuzzer afl++ is afl with community patches, qemu 5.1 upgrade, collision-free coverage, enhanced laf-intel & redqueen, AFLfast++ power schedules, MOpt mutators, unicorn_mode, and a lot more!

children.title: LibAFL
children.description: (2022) - A Rust framework for building custom fuzzers from reusable components, with support for multiple platforms and scaling across cores and machines.

repo_info.description: Advanced Fuzzing Library - Slot your Fuzzer together in Rust! Scales across cores and machines. For Windows, Android, MacOS, Linux, no_std, ...

children.title: Driller
children.description: (2016) - A hybrid fuzzer that augments AFL with selective symbolic execution using angr to generate inputs for paths that fuzzing cannot reach.

repo_info.description: Driller: augmenting AFL with symbolic execution!

children.title: Angora
children.description: (2018) - A mutation-based coverage guided fuzzer that increases branch coverage by solving path constraints without symbolic execution.

repo_info.description: Angora is a mutation-based fuzzer.  The main goal of Angora is to increase branch coverage by solving path constraints without symbolic execution.

children.title: QSYM
children.description: (2018) - A concolic execution engine designed for hybrid fuzzing that works with AFL to generate inputs for new execution paths.

repo_info.description: QSYM: A Practical Concolic Execution Engine Tailored for Hybrid Fuzzing

children.title: WINNIE
children.description: (2021) - A Windows application fuzzer that combines harness synthesis with fast process cloning to test code beyond graphical interfaces.

repo_info.description: Winnie makes fuzzing Windows applications easy

children.title: AFLGo
children.description: (2017) - An AFL-based directed greybox fuzzer that generates inputs to reach specified target locations in a program.

repo_info.description: Directed Greybox Fuzzing with AFL

children.title: AFLFast
children.description: (2016) - An AFL-based greybox fuzzer that uses power schedules to focus fuzzing effort on low-frequency execution paths.

repo_info.description: AFLFast (extends AFL with Power Schedules)

children.title: REDQUEEN
children.description: (2019) - A binary fuzzer that uses input-to-state correspondence to overcome magic bytes and checksums without symbolic execution.

children.title: MOpt-AFL
children.description: (2019) - An AFL-based fuzzer that uses particle swarm optimization to adapt mutation operator selection probabilities for more effective fuzzing.

repo_info.description: MOpt-AFL provided by the paper "MOPT: Optimized Mutation Scheduling for Fuzzers"

children.title: VUzzer
children.description: (2017) - An application-aware binary fuzzer that uses static analysis and dynamic taint analysis to guide input mutations, with a 64-bit implementation.

repo_info.description: This implements a 64-bit version of vusec/vuzzer fuzzing tool.

children.title: InsTrim
children.description: (2018) - A lightweight instrumentation approach for AFL that uses control-flow analysis to reduce the number of instrumented basic blocks while preserving execution path distinguishability.

repo_info.description: InsTrim: Lightweight Instrumentation for Coverage-guided Fuzzing

children.title: G2FUZZ
children.description: (2025) - An AFL++-based fuzzer that uses LLMs to synthesize and mutate input generators for grammar-aware fuzzing of non-textual formats.

children.title: syzkaller
children.description: (2015) - An unsupervised coverage-guided kernel fuzzer supporting FreeBSD, Fuchsia, gVisor, Linux, NetBSD, OpenBSD, and Windows.

repo_info.description: syzkaller is an unsupervised coverage-guided kernel fuzzer

children.title: Trinity
children.description: (2012) - A Linux system call fuzzer that generates semi-intelligent random arguments to syscalls, including valid file descriptors, flags, and range-biased values.

repo_info.description: Linux system call fuzzer

children.title: kAFL
children.description: (2017) - A hardware-assisted x86-64 VM kernel fuzzing framework with performant VM reloads for finding OS kernel vulnerabilities.

repo_info.description: Code for the USENIX 2017 paper: kAFL: Hardware-Assisted Feedback Fuzzing for OS Kernels

children.title: DIFUZE
children.description: (2017) - An interface-aware fuzzer for Linux kernel drivers that automatically recovers ioctl interfaces via LLVM analysis and generates targeted test cases.

repo_info.description: Fuzzer for Linux Kernel Drivers

children.title: Razzer
children.description: (2019) - A kernel fuzzer that uses static analysis and two-phase fuzzing to detect race conditions and concurrency bugs in Linux kernels.

repo_info.description: A Kernel fuzzer focusing on race bugs

children.title: Janus
children.description: (2019) - A file system fuzzer that finds memory corruptions in Linux kernel file systems by mutating both filesystem images and syscall sequences simultaneously.

repo_info.description: Janus: a state-of-the-art file system fuzzer on Linux

children.title: Hydra
children.description: (2019) - A fuzzing framework for automatically discovering semantic bugs in file systems using input mutators, feedback engines, and customizable checkers.

repo_info.description: Hydra: an Extensible Fuzzing Framework for Finding Semantic Bugs in File Systems

children.title: VirtFuzz
children.description: (2024) - A LibAFL-based Linux kernel fuzzer that injects inputs through VirtIO devices to test wireless stacks.

repo_info.description: VirtFuzz is a Linux Kernel Fuzzer that uses VirtIO to provide inputs into the kernels subsystem. It is built with LibAFL.

children.title: NTFuzz
children.description: (2021) - A type-aware Windows kernel fuzzer that statically analyzes system binaries to infer system call types for more effective fuzzing.

repo_info.description: NTFUZZ: Enabling Type-Aware Kernel Fuzzing on Windows with Static Binary Analysis (IEEE S&P '21)

children.title: IMF
children.description: (2017) - A kernel API fuzzer that leverages automated API model inference to discover vulnerabilities in macOS kernel APIs.

repo_info.description: Inferred Model-based Fuzzer

children.title: StateFuzz
children.description: (2022) - A Linux driver fuzzer that identifies state variables through static analysis and uses their values as fuzzing feedback.

repo_info.description: StateFuzz: System Call-Based State-Aware Linux Driver Fuzzing

children.title: KextFuzz
children.description: (2023) - A fuzzing prototype for macOS kernel extensions on Apple Silicon that instruments extensions and patches entitlement checks.

repo_info.description: Code of KextFuzz: Fuzzing macOS Kernel EXTensions on Apple Silicon via Exploiting Mitigations (USENIX Security'23)

children.title: PeriScope
children.description: (2019) - A probing and fuzzing framework that tests device drivers at the hardware-OS boundary through MMIO and DMA inputs.

children.title: SyzGen
children.description: (2021) - A syscall specification generator that analyzes closed-source macOS drivers to enable interface-aware fuzzing.

children.title: ACTOR
children.description: (2023) - An action-guided kernel fuzzing framework that generates inputs leveraging triggered actions and their temporal relationships.

repo_info.description: Source code for ACTOR, an action-guided kernel fuzzer (USENIX 2023 paper)

children.title: SyzDirect
children.description: (2023) - A directed greybox fuzzer for reaching target locations in the Linux kernel.

children.title: FuzzUSB
children.description: (2022) - A hybrid stateful fuzzing framework for USB gadget stacks in the Linux kernel.

children.title: FuzzNG
children.description: (2023) - A Linux kernel syscall fuzzer designed to minimize reliance on manually written system call descriptions.

children.title: SegFuzz
children.description: (2023) - A kernel concurrency fuzzer that uses interleaving segment coverage and mutation-based thread scheduling to discover bugs.

children.title: KRACE
children.description: (2020) - A coverage-guided fuzzing framework that detects data races in kernel file systems by exploring concurrency through multi-threaded syscall sequences.

repo_info.description: Source code release for the KRace project

children.title: CountDown
children.description: (2024) - A kernel fuzzer that uses shared reference counts to guide syscall sequences toward use-after-free bugs.

repo_info.description: A Refcount-guided Fuzzer for Exposing Temporal Memory Errors in Linux Kernel

children.title: DR.FUZZ
children.description: (2022) - A semantic-informed driver fuzzer that tests Linux device drivers without their hardware devices or device emulators.

children.title: Moneta
children.description: (2025) - A GPU driver fuzzer that recalls execution states captured on real hardware for ex-vivo fuzzing.

children.title: MOCK
children.description: (2024) - A Linux kernel fuzzer that learns contextual dependencies between syscalls to generate context-aware test cases.

repo_info.description: [NDSS'24] MOCK: Optimizing Kernel Fuzzing Mutation with Context-aware Dependency

children.title: SyzTrust
children.description: (2024) - An on-device fuzzer for IoT trusted operating systems that uses state and branch coverage to guide input generation.

repo_info.description: SyzTrust's main repository. Start here to install.

children.title: SyzSpec
children.description: (2025) - A specification generator for Linux kernel fuzzing that uses under-constrained symbolic execution to infer syscall interfaces.

children.title: Drifuzz
children.description: (2022) - A hardware-free device driver fuzzer that combines concolic execution with high-quality initial seed generation.

children.title: Hopper
children.description: (2023) - A library fuzzer that interprets generated API calls and learns argument constraints without requiring manually written fuzz drivers.

repo_info.description: Hopper is a tool for generating fuzzing test cases for libraries automatically using interpretative fuzzing.

children.title: GraphFuzz
children.description: An experimental framework for building structure-aware, library API fuzzers.

repo_info.description: GraphFuzz is an experimental framework for building structure-aware, library API fuzzers.

children.title: ChatAFL
children.description: (2024) - An AFLNet-based protocol fuzzer that uses LLMs to infer message grammars, enrich seeds, and generate messages that explore new protocol states.

repo_info.description: Large Language Model guided Protocol Fuzzing (NDSS'24)

children.title: SGFuzz
children.description: (2022) - A libFuzzer-based fuzzer that adds state-transition feedback to explore stateful software, including network protocol implementations.

children.title: ResolverFuzz
children.description: (2024) - A DNS fuzzer that combines query-response generation with differential analysis to detect non-crash vulnerabilities in resolvers.

repo_info.description: Official repository for ResolverFuzz

children.title: WuppieFuzz
children.description: A coverage-guided REST API fuzzer developed on top of LibAFL.

repo_info.description: A coverage-guided REST API fuzzer developed on top of LibAFL

children.title: Witcher
children.description: A web application fuzzer that utilizes mutational fuzzing to explore web applications and fault escalation to detect command and SQL injection vulnerabilities.

repo_info.description: Witcher is the first framework for using AFL to fuzz web applications.

children.title: RestTestGen
children.description: A robust tool and framework designed for automated black-box testing of RESTful web APIs.

repo_info.description: A framework for automated black-box testing of RESTful APIs.

children.title: MINER
children.description: A REST API fuzzer that utilizes three data-driven designs working together to guide sequence generation, improve request generation quality, and capture unique errors caused by incorrect parameter usage.

repo_info.description: MINER provided by the paper "MINER: A Hybrid Data-Driven Approach for REST API Fuzzing"

children.title: TEFuzz
children.description: A tailored fuzzing-based framework to facilitate the detection and exploitation of template escape bugs.

children.title: FreeDom
children.description: (2020) - A DOM fuzzer that generates HTML documents and DOM interactions to discover browser vulnerabilities.

repo_info.description: A DOM fuzzer

children.title: FuzzOrigin
children.description: (2022) - A browser fuzzer that tests origin handling to discover universal cross-site scripting vulnerabilities.

children.title: CorbFuzz
children.description: (2021) - A browser security policy testing framework that synthesizes web application responses to test cross-origin response blocking implementations.

repo_info.description: Code for ASE'21 Paper "CorbFuzz: Checking Browser Security Policies with Fuzzing"

children.title: CodeAlchemist
children.description: (2019) - A JavaScript engine fuzzer that assembles code fragments while respecting semantic constraints to generate valid test programs.

repo_info.description: CodeAlchemist: Semantics-Aware Code Generation to Find Vulnerabilities in JavaScript Engines (NDSS '19)

children.title: FuzzJIT
children.description: (2023) - A Fuzzilli-based JavaScript engine fuzzer that uses an oracle to detect incorrect behavior introduced by JIT compilation.

children.title: RGFuzz
children.description: (2025) - A WebAssembly runtime fuzzer that uses compiler rules to guide test generation and compares execution results across runtimes and architectures.

repo_info.description: RGFuzz: Rule-Guided Fuzzer for WebAssembly Runtimes

children.title: FIRM-AFL
children.description: (2019) - An IoT firmware fuzzer that combines user-mode and system-mode emulation to improve fuzzing throughput for POSIX-compatible firmware.

repo_info.description: FIRM-AFL is the first high-throughput greybox fuzzer for IoT firmware.

children.title: Fuzzware
children.description: (2022) - A firmware fuzzer that models memory-mapped I/O accesses to test microcontroller firmware without full peripheral emulation.

repo_info.description: Fuzzware's main repository. Start here to install.

children.title: Hoedur
children.description: (2023) - An embedded firmware fuzzer that uses multiple input streams to represent interactions with different hardware interfaces.

children.title: V-SHUTTLE
children.description: (2021) - An AFL-based fuzzer for virtual devices in hosted hypervisors, with semantics-aware input generation.

children.title: HyperPill
children.description: (2024) - A hypervisor fuzzer that uses the hardware virtualization interface to exercise hypervisor behavior without hypervisor-specific input grammars.

children.title: ViDeZZo
children.description: (2023) - A virtual device fuzzing framework that models dependencies within and between messages to test devices in QEMU and VirtualBox.

repo_info.description: ViDeZZo source code.

children.title: DifuzzRTL
children.description: A differential fuzz testing approach for CPU verification.

children.title: MorFuzz
children.description: A generic RISC-V processor fuzzing framework that can efficiently detect software triggerable functional bugs.

repo_info.description: Artifact evaluation of paper: MorFuzz: Fuzzing Processor via Runtime Instruction Morphing enhanced Synchronizable Co-simulation

children.title: SpecFuzz
children.description: A tool that exposes speculative execution paths through software instrumentation so fuzzers can detect Spectre-type vulnerabilities in programs.

repo_info.description: A tool to enable fuzzing for Spectre vulnerabilities

children.title: Transynther
children.description: Automatically generates and tests building blocks for Meltdown attacks with various faults and microcode assists.

repo_info.description: Medusa Repository: Transynther tool and Medusa Attack

children.title: FANS
children.description: A fuzzing tool for Android native system services with four components: interface collector, interface model extractor, dependency inferer, and fuzzer engine.

repo_info.description: FANS: Fuzzing Android Native System Services

children.title: MALintent
children.description: (2025) - A coverage-guided Android fuzzer that generates and mutates intents to test application intent receivers.

children.title: AHA-Fuzz
children.description: (2025) - An intent-aware greybox fuzzer that uses eBPF-based analysis to test hardened Android applications.

children.title: ILF
children.description: (2019) - An Ethereum smart contract fuzzer that learns a transaction-generation policy from symbolic execution through imitation learning.

repo_info.description: AI based fuzzer based on imitation learning

children.title: Fluffy
children.description: A multi-transaction differential fuzzer for finding consensus bugs in Ethereum.

repo_info.description: Ethereum VM fuzzer

children.title: LOKI
children.description: A Blockchain consensus protocol fuzzing framework that detects consensus memory related and logic bugs.

repo_info.description: A blockchain consensus protocol fuzzing framework

children.title: Squirrel
children.description: A fuzzer for database management systems (DBMSs).

children.title: SQLRight
children.description: (2022) - A DBMS fuzzer that combines coverage feedback, validity-oriented query mutations, and result-checking oracles to detect logical bugs.

repo_info.description: Coveraged-based fuzzer for finding DBMS logical bugs

children.title: BuzzBee
children.description: (2024) - A DBMS fuzzer that uses semantic abstraction, context-sensitive constraints, and dependency-guided mutations to generate database queries.

items.title: Tools

original_repository_info.description: A curated list of awesome Fuzzing(or Fuzz Testing) for software security
